SELECT -- 1. 累计总收益 (历史所有时间的钱全部加起来) IFNULL(SUM( CASE WHEN sales_user_id = #{userId} THEN sales_amount ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN team_user_id = #{userId} THEN team_amount ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN project_user_id = #{userId} THEN project_amount ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS totalAmount,
-- 2. 当月/指定月预估收益 (根据前端传的时间来算) IFNULL(SUM( CASE -- 如果前端传了月份参数 (如 '2026-03')
WHEN DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') = #{queryMonth}
-- 如果前端没传参数，默认算数据库当前的月份
WHEN DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m')
THEN (CASE WHEN sales_user_id = #{userId} THEN sales_amount ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN team_user_id = #{userId} THEN team_amount ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN project_user_id = #{userId} THEN project_amount ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS monthAmount
FROM biz_commission_record WHERE status = 0 AND del_flag = '0' AND (sales_user_id = #{userId} OR team_user_id = #{userId} OR project_user_id = #{userId})
